question: An architect was building a hotel downtown. He bought 147 lamps to put in the rooms. If each room gets 7 lamps, how many rooms does the hotel have?
Amy had 180 video games. If she placed the games into 9 different stacks, how many games would be in each stack?
There are 336 students in a school. If the school has 7 grades and each grade had the same number of students, how many students were in each grade?
The ring toss game at the carnival made 420 dollars in 3 days. If they made the same amount of money each day, how much did they make per day?
An ice machine had 294 ice cubes in it. If you were filling up 7 ice chests and each chest got the same number of cubes, how many ice cubes would each chest get?
Amy uploaded 180 pics to Facebook. If she put the pics into 9 albums with the same number of photos in each album, how many photos were in each album?
A farmer had 225 seeds to plant. He planted the same number of seeds each day and it took him 5 days to plant them all. How many seeds did he plant per day?
A mailman has to give out 192 pieces of junk mail. If he goes to 4 blocks, how many pieces of junk mail should he give each block?
For Halloween Adam received 201 pieces of candy. If he put them into piles with 43 in each pile, approximately how many piles could he make?
An electronics store had 163 video games. If they put them on shelves with 84 on each shelf, about how many shelves would they need?
Cody had 36 boxes. Together the boxes weighed 243 kilograms. About how much did each box weigh?
There were 31 groups of people at the bowling alley. If the total number of people was 177, about how many people were in each group?
A class collected 122 cans for recycling. If they could put 57 cans in each bag, approximately how many bags would they need?
Paige had a sheet of paper that was 9 inches long and 10 inches wide. What is the area of the paper?
Rachel bought some wrapping paper for Christmas that was 4 feet long and with an area of 20 square feet. What is the width of the wrapping paper?
A bathroom had a length of 4 feet and a total area of 8 square feet. What is the width of the bathroom?
Adam was painting a wall in his room. The wall was 4 feet wide and 4 feet tall. What is the area of the wall he has to paint?
A rectangle flower bed had a total area of 35 square yards. If it was 5 yards wide, how long was it?
Adam was painting a picture frame. The frame was 6 inches wide and 9 inches tall. What is the perimeter of the picture frame?
A movie poster was 4 inches wide and 7 inches tall. What is the area of the poster?
Adam bought a new flat screen TV with an area of 21 square feets. The screen is 3 feet wide. How tall is it?
A restaurant added a new outdoor section that was 35 square feet. It was 7 feet wide. How long is their new section?
Billy was painting a wall in his room. The total area was 8 square feet. If the wall was 2 feet wide, how tall is it?
An envelope from the post office is 4 inches wide and 4 inches long. What is the area of the envelope?
The woods behind Jerry's house were 6 miles wide and 3 miles long. What is the area of the woods?
